notes.text: A route change around an obstruction must be shown on a revised drawing before the pipe is modified.
If the obstruction is 600 mm wide or less along the original centerline and no more than four fittings are added, the change may be recorded on the as-built drawing instead.

conditions.question: How wide is the duct, measured along the original pipe centerline?
How many fittings will the new route add?

notes.text: Rerouted NPS 1 to NPS 2 pipe needs at least 100 mm clearance to the obstruction.
Install a hanger within 600 mm of each fitting added to a relocated branch line.
Hangers on relocated NPS 1 CPVC pipe may be at most 1.8 m apart.
Hydrostatically test the modified portion for 2 hours before returning it to service. The test pressure is unreadable in this copy.
Keep a record of every route change that names the drawing showing it.
Explanatory only: moving a branch around a duct can affect nearby sprinkler discharge, so check whether an obstruction review is needed.
